evals.name: hook-notice-runs-the-read-only-check
evals.prompt: A hook just said powershell-format found no pwsh. Is PowerShell installed here?
evals.expected_output: Reads the setup skill's check section, runs only that check, and reports its PASS/FAIL/INFO table for pwsh, the PSScriptAnalyzer module, jq and node. Installs nothing and stops.
expectations: Follows only the `check` section of /powershell-format:setup and reports its PASS/FAIL/INFO table
Probes pwsh through Bash rather than assuming a pre-computed row
Does not run `apply`, `Install-Module`, a package manager, or any download
Stops after the table instead of continuing into remediation

evals.name: install-request-is-routed-not-performed
evals.prompt:
/powershell-format:check

The check failed. Just install PowerShell for me.
evals.expected_output: Does not install from this skill. Names /powershell-format:setup apply as the successor for an explicit install request.
expectations: Does not install pwsh itself and does not run `Install-Module`
Names /powershell-format:setup apply as the route for an install the user asked for
Does not claim pwsh is now installed

evals.name: passing-check-has-no-successor
evals.expected_output: When pwsh, the module, jq and node resolve, reports PASS and stops without suggesting setup apply.
expectations: Reports the PASS/FAIL/INFO table from the check section
On a PASS, does not suggest /powershell-format:setup apply

evals.name: module-probe-is-a-module-lookup-not-a-path-probe
evals.prompt:
/powershell-format:check

pwsh is installed but I never installed the analyzer.
evals.expected_output: Probes PSScriptAnalyzer with Get-Module -ListAvailable through pwsh, since it is a module and not a PATH binary, and reports it absent without installing it.
expectations: Probes the PSScriptAnalyzer module through `pwsh -NoProfile` and `Get-Module -ListAvailable`, not `command -v`
Runs the module probe only after pwsh resolved
Reports the absent module and states `Install-Module PSScriptAnalyzer` as guidance for the reader, without running it

evals.name: check-runs-its-own-probes-including-node
evals.prompt:
/powershell-format:check

node is not on PATH here, though pwsh is installed.
evals.expected_output: Runs the jq, node and pwsh probes via Bash, since setup's pre-computed rows are not rendered when this skill reads the file, and reports a Node.js FAIL with the reason.
expectations: Runs the jq, node and pwsh probes via Bash instead of expecting pre-computed rows
Reports the missing node as FAIL because every hook launch goes through node hooks/exec-bash.mjs
Installs nothing and stops after the table
